name: Amagasaki Ayaka
source:
A kind and innocent woman.

She has an honest, gentle and calm personality.

She generally trusts people and has no idea how to doubt them.

She has sexual desires, but even if she is not sexually satisfied, she likes to pamper men.

Even if she is embraced almost forcefully, she accepts the man and ends up accepting him.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/tanshin_furin/]official site[/url]]
